name: icpac-geonode-tropical-cyclones-hitting-somali-regions-for-the-period-1984-2020
notes:
Tropical cyclones hitting Somalia Regions for the period between 1984 to 2020. This layer indicates the frequency of cyclone occurence within specific regions of Somalia. The cyclones recorded include:

  1. 1984 Tropical Cyclone 1A
  2. 1984 Tropical Cyclone 4B
  3. 1992 Tropical Cyclone 12A
  4. 1994 Tropical Cyclone 05A
  5. 1997 Tropical Cyclone 03A
  6. 2004 Tropical Cyclone Agni
  7. 2010 Tropical Cyclone Bandu
  8. 2012 Tropical Cyclone Murjan
  9. 2013 Tropical Cyclone 3A
  10. 2015 Tropical Cyclone Chapala
  11. 2015 Tropical Cyclone Megh
  12. 2018 Tropical Cyclone Sagar
  13. 2019 Tropical Cyclone Pawan
  14. 2020 Tropical Cyclone Gati
